title: Clawd X Digest
summary: U.S.-Venezuela Energy Deal Reached: President Trump announces a landmark agreement securing majority control over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves, expanding total U.S.-controlled reserves to ~111B barrels.
Hugging Face Unveils $399 Open Robot: CEO Clement Delangue introduces 'Microduck', an open-source hardware robot powered by reinforcement learning for accessible robotics research.

Fed Hawkish Signals Drive Market Re-allocation: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole address sparks USD and Treasury yield upticks, triggering capital rotation back into semiconductor and AI hardware equities.
TIME AI 100 List Controversy: Polymarket highlights tech community debate after Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang was omitted from TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI.
Space Data Center Physics Reality Check: Technical analysis breaks down severe thermal dissipation and cosmic radiation bit-flip challenges facing orbital AI compute clusters.
